biggest_catch: No escrow or payment protection — forum deals are peer-to-peer, so scam risk is entirely on you.
catches: No escrow, no contracts handled, no payment protection — negotiate and verify counterparties yourself.
Forum marketplaces attract scammers; never pay upfront or share credentials.
Pay is per-deal and set by negotiation — no fixed range.
Reputation matters: new accounts with no history win fewer deals.

c1.evidence: Digital Point's official Services Marketplace forum is live with hundreds of pages of listings across Content Creation (65k+ discussions), Design, Programming, Traffic, and Web Hosting: 'If you are looking for (or offering) services, this is the forum to use. This includes job listings, etc.' — a real, public deal channel.

c2.evidence: Official pages publish no fixed pay range — pay is negotiated per deal; framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the forum flow: register free, post service offers or browse wanted ads, negotiate in threads/DMs, deliver, get paid directly.

c4.evidence: Registering and posting on the forum carries no upfront fee.

eligibility: Anyone who can register on the forum and deliver content, design, programming, traffic, or hosting services.
notes: Scenario: freelance forum marketplace. Pay is negotiated per deal and variable — never guaranteed, with no platform payment protection.

steps: Register free on the Digital Point forums.
Post your service offer in the matching Services Marketplace subforum (Content Creation, Design, Programming, Traffic, or Web Hosting) — or browse wanted ads.
Negotiate scope and price in the thread or via DM.
Deliver the work and get paid directly (no forum escrow — use a payment method you trust).
